title: Zesty Middle Eastern Petit Pois Ti Leaf Wrap
description: A sweet and tender solo dinner dish featuring petit pois in a Middle Eastern style, wrapped in a ti leaf for a unique and flavorful meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the petit pois with olive oil, chopped onion, minced garlic, lemon juice, paprika, salt, and black pepper until they are well coated.
Lay a ti leaf flat on a work surface and place about 1/4 cup of the petit pois mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end of the ti leaf over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining ti leaves and filling.
Place the ti leaf wraps in a baking dish and bake for 15 minutes.
Serve the ti leaf wraps hot, garnished with lemon wedges if desired.
